entities.name: Ravos
entities.description: Legendary human cleric and oracle of Athreos on Theros.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead to which Athreos guides souls.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Sleep Curse Ravos helped counteract.

events.summary: Ravos struck a deal with Athreos to see his dead lover once a year in exchange for helping guide the dead.
events.quote: he struck a deal with the god

events.summary: Ravos secretly defied Athreos by escorting wards back to the land of the living.
events.quote: secretly defies Athreos by escorting his wards back to the land of the living

events.summary: Ravos helped counteract Ashiok's Sleep Curse.
